snippet.title: Intro to Geology: Crash Course Geology #1
snippet.description:
There’s no place like Earth—and we’ve got the planet’s spectacular, one-of-a-kind geology to thank for it. In this episode of Crash Course Geology, we’ll explore how geology touches our lives, helps us solve mysteries about the planet’s past and its future, and puts our world life in perspective.

What is Geology 0:40
Fall Lines and Settlement Patterns 3:37
Jobs of Geologists 5:58
Review and Credits 7:59

snippet.title: Rebuilding A Forest? Just Add Termites
snippet.description:
If you were to guess which organism might be counted on to restore a plot of destroyed rainforest, termites might not be the first thing that comes up. But one group of Australian researchers say these little wood-eating insects are probably /exactly/ what's needed to revitalize a wrecked rainforest.

snippet.title: 10 Simple Habits That Help Combat Anxiety
snippet.description:
10 Simple Habits That Help Combat Anxiety

Watch more Psychology Videos: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLGk034V02sFYNfXhtEMPx02SM-RSfpHZr

Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@Mind_Insight-24?sub_confirmation=1

Chronic anxiety can be debilitating and interfere with living a full life. Constant stress, a frantic pace, and an endless to-do list are often a source of anxiety. But there are ways to help you restore balance and reduce anxiety.
In this video, we share 10 simple habits that will help you. These tips are small steps toward big changes that will help you feel calmer and more confident every day.
Watch until the end to find a habit that can change your life for the better!


00:00 Intro
00:22 Practice Deep Breathing
00:52 Engage in Physical Activity
01:23 Meditation and Mindfulness
01:50 Keep a Journal
02:14 Prioritize Healthy Sleep
02:41 Limit Caffeine and Alcohol
03:05 Seek Social Support
03:26 Focus on Hobbies and Interests
03:49 Practice Gratitude
04:13 Reduce Social Media Usage
04:36 Final Thoughts

#psychology #anxiety #reduceanxiety

snippet.title: The worst phrases you can hear in bed
snippet.description:
The worst phrases you can hear in bed

Watch more Psychology Videos: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLGk034V02sFYNfXhtEMPx02SM-RSfpHZr

Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/@Mind_Insight-24?sub_confirmation=1

Intimacy is not only about physical intimacy, but also about trust, comfort, and emotional connection. But some words can ruin everything! In this video, we'll figure out what phrases are best never to say during intimacy, why they can cause awkwardness or even serious problems in a relationship. Here the worst phrases you can hear in bed

💬 And what phrases do you find completely unacceptable in bed? Share in the comments!

00:00 Introduction
00:28 "Is that it?"
00:58 "My ex used to do it differently"
01:26 "Hurry up, I'm in a rush
01:53 "I thought you'd be better at this."
02:18 "I don't want to, but let's get it over with."
02:45 "That was better than I expected."
03:04 "I don't care."
03:28 How to avoid such situations?
03:53 Conclusion

#psychology #intimacy #relationship
